# Pagefind, the search indexer deploy.yml runs over _site after `jekyll build`
# (ADR-0020). `pagefind` is the pure-Python launcher (`python3 -m pagefind`);
# `pagefind-bin` carries the prebuilt binary. Exact pins with sha256, so pip
# runs in hash-checking mode like requirements-images.txt; Dependabot bumps
# pins and hashes together (see .github/dependabot.yml).
#
# The binary wheels are py3-none, one per platform rather than per Python
# version: the manylinux x86_64 hash is the one the runners install, win_amd64
# is for building the index locally (README, "Desenvolvimento local").
#
# The browser half of Pagefind (pagefind.js, the WebAssembly) is written into
# _site/pagefind/ by this same binary, so bumping this pin upgrades the search
# page's runtime too. search.html relies on 1.5.x behaviour (ADR-0020); check
# /busca/ in both languages after a bump.
pagefind[bin]==1.6.0 \
    --hash=sha256:744864df19d4dc0d75873ec9117e67328a1aaa208151c7acfca5fab03dcc41d8 \
    --hash=sha256:c1ab35dd3573f95a8d8f25f9ffac30db8829577b5945641d1bdbf60620a3bd5c
pagefind-bin==1.6.0 \
    --hash=sha256:1adb6bf9b9ddce2a28983c8abb85211efdc7ac2d7945a3b55a95561f49f1f185 \
    --hash=sha256:4210638ca4eeaa26ec337d1903e4de0eae71d842feb1b1fa01055b1787504569 \
    --hash=sha256:5622ef851ae4cdd65a15cf62657348c6d490acf92417e772ad27e77b21ad301f \
    --hash=sha256:5f55c560e75431f40b0b89ed1d1c89df74dc7e8a90782ce9385ce495fbfba5a2 \
    --hash=sha256:9d8f127fa574bf3d06a08ca437f45ade03f9ddfafe08dcb1c804b0145b8cb37b \
    --hash=sha256:d2928909f37645ba44ff344bbef8b0083e45166a4d8d813101385d5b3f66d698
